preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 1000 for N in [N_val for N_val in []])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N (number of computers) is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(P, int) and N - 1 <= P <= 100000 for N, P in [])
preconditions.description: For each test case, P (number of connections) is an integer between N-1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(M, int) and 1 <= M <= 100000 for M in [])
preconditions.description: For each test case, M (number of queries) is an integer between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and 1 <= d <= 1000000 for u, v, d in [])
preconditions.description: For each connection, u and v are valid computer indices (1 to N) and distance d is between 1 and 1000000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(d for u, v, d in connections)) == len(connections) for connections in [])
preconditions.description: Within each test case, all distances d for connections are unique.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in [])
preconditions.description: For each query, u and v are valid computer indices (1 to N).

postconditions.description: The output starts with the case header 'Case: case_no' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(query_output == min_path_length(u, v, mst_edges) for query_output, (u, v) in zip(query_outputs, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (u, v), the output is the sum of distances along the unique path between u and v in the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) of the given graph.

postconditions.expression: mst_edges == sorted(connections, key=lambda x: x[2])[:N-1] if len(connections) >= N-1 else connections
postconditions.description: The MST is constructed by selecting the N-1 edges with the smallest distances from the given connections, ensuring all computers are connected with minimum total LAN length.
